verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own (v3) agent docs say you can customize the agent by specifying the LLM provider and model, which points to a model-agnostic design rather than lock-in to one vendor. That is the only evidence, though: a single mention scoped to `agent`, with nothing showing which providers are supported or how to plug in your own for act/extract/observe in v4. missing for 10: a list of supported providers, documented bring-your-own/custom LLM client configuration, evidence that provider choice covers act/extract/observe (not just agent) in current v4 docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of using non-default providers.
